assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
The service is associated with diagnosis code I25.10.
The service is associated with diagnosis code R42.
